original.statement: In v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer enables experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default; set providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel to true to enable them.

corrected.statement: In v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer enables experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default; set providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel to true to enable them.

decision.reason: [ev-5b58f5805519] says that in v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider does not enable experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default, and that the `experimentalChannel` option enables them. It never states a v2 default of true for providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel, so default-changed with before "true" is not supported. The evidence supports a behavior-changed on this config key with no before/after values: if the option is left unset, experimental channel resources are no longer supported.
